integrity: The proof is analytic and explicitly uses the published binary-itinerary correspondence. Its all-dimension optimal multiplier and extremal-cycle census are derived from the displayed hypotheses. A dependency-free exact-rational checker is provided; finite testing is corroboration, not a general proof. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the stated twisted baker map for integer dimensions at least four, excludes the nonisolated fixed face, and concerns least-period return eigenvalue moduli rather than singular values or nonperiodic Lyapunov exponents. The dimension-three exact extremal law is pre-existing and is not claimed as novel. Unindexed equivalent statements remain a priority risk.
title: Prime-divisor thresholds and exact weakest-cycle counts in higher-dimensional twisted baker maps
